as_told.title: Il Duce's telegram banning mention of an unknown aircraft landing

plain: In 1933, according to the Italian researcher Roberto Pinotti, Italy's Fascist government sent out telegrams ordering the press to say nothing about an unknown aircraft said to have landed in the country. Pinotti quotes one: "by the personal order of Il Duce," meaning the dictator Benito Mussolini, "absolutely no mention is to be made of the alleged landing of an unknown aircraft on national soil," and he links it to the Stefani agency, the news agency of the time. Michels brings it up as the subject of a book Pinotti wrote, as a sign that a government was hiding such a landing long before the modern UFO era.
